title: The global Kronecker–Weber theorem in Lean 4
summary: This project formalizes the global Kronecker–Weber theorem in Lean 4: every finite abelian extension of the rational numbers embeds into a cyclotomic field. For a number field L that is abelian Galois over the rationals, the selected declaration gives a positive integer n and a rational algebra embedding from L into CyclotomicField n ℚ. The proof is supplied by the ClassFieldTheory library at a fixed commit, using Lean 4.33.0 and Mathlib.

review.reason: Lean 4 formalization of the global Kronecker–Weber theorem for abelian number fields.
